com4_to_com3.failure_observation: Both failed initiator transactions timed out with state=-6 while responder USB logged RXERR crc. These are receive/CRC failures before a valid H2 PING can generate H2RESP, not observed long IRQ-to-handler events.

scheduler.interpretation: The strict matched-trace adjacency check is false because CRC-failed transactions do not emit H2RESP. Sequence 1 reports wait/wake=1 and sequence 3 reports wait/wake=3, consistent with an intervening task wake on sequence 2, whose responder log is RXERR crc. Sequence 20 has no subsequent H2RESP from which to recover the final cumulative counter.

latency_conclusion: On both physical boards, successful valid H2 frames are handled by the event-driven responder task with low-microsecond IRQ-to-handler latency while the Arduino loop retains a 1 ms idle delay. The approximately 1 ms polling modulation seen in HW-002T is absent in both directions.
reliability_boundary: The mirror run contains two responder CRC errors. The 18/20 bench count is descriptive only and must not be interpreted as deployment packet-loss probability. CRC reliability remains a separate follow-up from scheduler latency.
energy_boundary: Scheduler blocking/wakeup counters are software proxies only; no watts, joules, current draw, or battery-life claim is made without external electrical measurement.
